dedupe_keys.name: microscopic vehicle trajectories from heterogeneous and area based traffic traffic data from developing countries

description: Microscopic Vehicle Trajectories from Heterogeneous and Area-Based Traffic Traffic Data from Developing Countries is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Yawar Ali, K Ramachandra Rao (Indian Institute of Technology Delhi). Version "NDA 1 and NDA 2" pertains to the near-free-flow traffic regime. The Microscopic Vehicle Trajectory (MVT) data are from an urban midblock location in the National Capital Region of India, featuring highly heterogeneous and area-based traffic (weak lane-based/non-lane-based/disordered traffic, as you prefer to call it :D ^-^). Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
